name: P3.gradient_apply

name: P3.edgeMatrix_gradient_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeMatrix_gradient_apply
    (d : DiagZero (V := V)) (i j : V) :
    edgeMatrix (V := V) (gradient (V := V) d) i j =
      d.1.ofLp i - d.1.ofLp j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [edgeMatrix]
  · simp [edgeMatrix, h, gradient_apply]

name: P3.edge_inner_eq_double_sum
statement:
theorem edge_inner_eq_double_sum
    (f g : EdgeSpace V) :
    inner ℂ f g =
      ∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        edgeMatrix (V := V) g i j *
          star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp_rw [RCLike.inner_apply]
  change
    (∑ e : Edge V, g.ofLp e * star (f.ofLp e)) =
      ∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        edgeMatrix (V := V) g i j *
          star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j)
  have hsplit :=
    Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype
      (fun p : V × V => p.1 ≠ p.2)
      (fun p : V × V =>
        edgeMatrix (V := V) g p.1 p.2 *
          star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f p.1 p.2))
  have hdiag :
      (∑ p : {p : V × V // ¬ p.1 ≠ p.2},
        edgeMatrix (V := V) g p.1.1 p.1.2 *
          star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f p.1.1 p.1.2)) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    have hEq : p.1.1 = p.1.2 := not_ne_iff.mp p.2
    simp [hEq]
  rw [hdiag, add_zero, Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hsplit
  calc
    (∑ e : Edge V, g.ofLp e * star (f.ofLp e)) =
        ∑ e : Edge V,
          edgeMatrix (V := V) g e.1.1 e.1.2 *
            star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f e.1.1 e.1.2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e he
      rw [edgeMatrix_offdiag (V := V) g e.2,
          edgeMatrix_offdiag (V := V) f e.2]
    _ = ∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
          edgeMatrix (V := V) g i j *
            star (edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) := hsplit

name: P3.gradient_divergence_adjoint
statement:
theorem gradient_divergence_adjoint
    (f : EdgeSpace V) (d : DiagZero (V := V)) :
    inner ℂ (divergence (V := V) f) d =
      inner ℂ f (gradient (V := V) d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.coe_inner]
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp_rw [RCLike.inner_apply, divergence_apply]
  rw [edge_inner_eq_double_sum (V := V)]
  simp_rw [edgeMatrix_gradient_apply]

  simp_rw [map_sub, map_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

  have hswap :
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        d.1.ofLp i * (starRingEnd ℂ) (edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i)) =
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        d.1.ofLp j * (starRingEnd ℂ) (edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j)) := by
    exact Finset.sum_comm

  rw [hswap]
  simp_rw [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rfl

name: P3.mem_residueOrthogonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_residueOrthogonal
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) (d : DiagZero (V := V)) :
    d ∈ residueOrthogonal (V := V) φ k ↔
      ∀ r ∈ residue φ k, inner ℂ r d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.mem_stabilizer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_stabilizer
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) (d : DiagZero (V := V)) :
    d ∈ stabilizer (V := V) φ k ↔
      ∀ f ∈ hiddenFlow φ k,
        inner ℂ f (gradient (V := V) d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.residueOrthogonal_eq_stabilizer
statement:
theorem residueOrthogonal_eq_stabilizer
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    residueOrthogonal (V := V) φ k =
      stabilizer (V := V) φ k
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [mem_residueOrthogonal, mem_stabilizer]
  constructor
  · intro hd f hf
    have hdiv : divergence (V := V) f ∈ residue φ k := by
      rw [residue_eq_map_divergence (V := V) φ k]
      exact ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hzero :
        inner ℂ (divergence (V := V) f) d = 0 :=
      hd (divergence (V := V) f) hdiv
    rw [gradient_divergence_adjoint (V := V) f d] at hzero
    exact hzero
  · intro hd r hr
    rw [residue_eq_map_divergence (V := V) φ k] at hr
    rcases hr with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hzero :
        inner ℂ f (gradient (V := V) d) = 0 :=
      hd f hf
    rw [← gradient_divergence_adjoint (V := V) f d] at hzero
    exact hzero

name: P3.residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residue φ k) =
      Fintype.card V -
        componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:=
  finrank_residue_eq_card_sub_componentCount_of_graphSaturated
    (V := V) φ k hsat

name: P3.componentCount_le_card
statement:
theorem componentCount_le_card
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    componentCount (V := V) G ≤ Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
      (componentSum (V := V) G)
  rw [finrank_componentSum_range (V := V) G,
      finrank_graphVertexSpace (V := V)] at h
  omega

name: P3.residueGrowth_eq_component_drop
statement:
theorem residueGrowth_eq_component_drop
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat_k : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k)
    (hsat_succ : graphSaturated (V := V) φ (k + 1)) :
    residueGrowth φ (k + 1) =
      componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) -
        componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hrank_k :=
    residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated
      (V := V) φ k hsat_k
  have hrank_succ :=
    residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated
      (V := V) φ (k + 1) hsat_succ
  have hgrowth := residueDim_add_growth (V := V) φ k
  change
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residue φ k) +
        residueGrowth φ (k + 1) =
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residue φ (k + 1)) at hgrowth
  rw [hrank_k, hrank_succ] at hgrowth
  have hk_bound :
      componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) ≤
        Fintype.card V :=
    componentCount_le_card (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
  have hsucc_bound :
      componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ (k + 1)) ≤
        Fintype.card V :=
    componentCount_le_card (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ (k + 1))
  omega

name: P3.mem_componentConstant
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_componentConstant
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (d : DiagZero (V := V)) :
    d ∈ componentConstant (V := V) G ↔
      ∀ i j : V,
        G.connectedComponentMk i = G.connectedComponentMk j →
          d.1.ofLp i = d.1.ofLp j
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.inner_eq_coordinatePairing
statement:
theorem inner_eq_coordinatePairing
    (r d : DiagZero (V := V)) :
    inner ℂ r d =
      coordinatePairing (V := V)
        (diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) r) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.coe_inner, PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp_rw [RCLike.inner_apply]
  rfl

name: P3.coordinatePairing_edgeDifference
statement:
theorem coordinatePairing_edgeDifference
    (d : DiagZero (V := V)) (i j : V) :
    coordinatePairing (V := V)
        (edgeDifference (V := V) i j) d =
      d.1.ofLp i - d.1.ofLp j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coordinatePairing, edgeDifference, vertexDelta,
    mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: P3.incidenceSpace_le_coordinateAnnihilator_of_componentConstant
statement:
theorem incidenceSpace_le_coordinateAnnihilator_of_componentConstant
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (d : DiagZero (V := V))
    (hd : d ∈ componentConstant (V := V) G) :
    incidenceSpace (V := V) G ≤ coordinateAnnihilator (V := V) d
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩
  change coordinatePairing (V := V)
      (edgeDifference (V := V) i j) d = 0
  rw [coordinatePairing_edgeDifference]
  have hcomp :
      G.connectedComponentMk i = G.connectedComponentMk j :=
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hij
  rw [(mem_componentConstant (V := V) G d).mp hd i j hcomp]
  exact sub_self _

name: P3.stabilizer_le_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem stabilizer_le_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    stabilizer (V := V) φ k ≤
      componentConstant (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [mem_componentConstant]
  intro i j hcomp
  have hdR : d ∈ residueOrthogonal (V := V) φ k := by
    rw [residueOrthogonal_eq_stabilizer (V := V) φ k]
    exact hd
  have hedge :
      edgeDifference (V := V) i j ∈
        incidenceSpace (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) :=
    edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_component_eq
      (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) hcomp
  have hedgeR :
      edgeDifference (V := V) i j ∈
        residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k := by
    rw [hsat]
    exact hedge
  rcases hedgeR with ⟨r, hr, hcoord⟩
  have hzero : inner ℂ r d = 0 :=
    (mem_residueOrthogonal (V := V) φ k d).mp hdR r hr
  rw [inner_eq_coordinatePairing (V := V) r d] at hzero
  rw [hcoord, coordinatePairing_edgeDifference] at hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

name: P3.componentConstant_le_stabilizer_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem componentConstant_le_stabilizer_of_graphSaturated
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    componentConstant (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) ≤
      stabilizer (V := V) φ k
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [← residueOrthogonal_eq_stabilizer (V := V) φ k]
  rw [mem_residueOrthogonal]
  intro r hr
  have hcoord :
      diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) r ∈
        residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k :=
    ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  have hinc :
      diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) r ∈
        incidenceSpace (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) := by
    rw [← hsat]
    exact hcoord
  have hann :=
    incidenceSpace_le_coordinateAnnihilator_of_componentConstant
      (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) d hd hinc
  change coordinatePairing (V := V)
      (diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) r) d = 0 at hann
  rw [inner_eq_coordinatePairing (V := V) r d]
  exact hann

name: P3.stabilizer_eq_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem stabilizer_eq_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    stabilizer (V := V) φ k =
      componentConstant (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact stabilizer_le_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
      (V := V) φ k hsat
  · exact componentConstant_le_stabilizer_of_graphSaturated
      (V := V) φ k hsat

name: P3.componentValueSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentValueSum_apply
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (a : G.ConnectedComponent → ℂ) :
    componentValueSum (V := V) G a =
      ∑ v : V, a (G.connectedComponentMk v)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.componentValueSum_surjective
statement:
theorem componentValueSum_surjective
    [Nonempty V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (componentValueSum (V := V) G)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hcard : (Fintype.card V : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card V ≠ 0)
  refine ⟨fun _ => z / (Fintype.card V : ℂ), ?_⟩
  change (∑ _v : V, z / (Fintype.card V : ℂ)) = z
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ]
  field_simp [hcard]

name: P3.finrank_componentValueSum_ker
statement:
theorem finrank_componentValueSum_ker
    [Nonempty V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.ker (componentValueSum (V := V) G)) =
      componentCount (V := V) G - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrange :
      LinearMap.range (componentValueSum (V := V) G) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr
      (componentValueSum_surjective (V := V) G)
  have h :=
    LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
      (componentValueSum (V := V) G)
  rw [hrange, finrank_top, CommSemiring.finrank_self,
      finrank_componentSpace (V := V) G] at h
  exact Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq' h

name: P3.componentConstantToKernel_injective
statement:
theorem componentConstantToKernel_injective
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Injective (componentConstantToKernel (V := V) G)
proof:
:= by
  intro d e hde
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (V → ℂ)).injective
  ext v
  have hd :=
    (mem_componentConstant (V := V) G d.1).mp d.2
      (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))
      v
      (connectedComponentMk_componentRep
        (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))
  have he :=
    (mem_componentConstant (V := V) G e.1).mp e.2
      (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))
      v
      (connectedComponentMk_componentRep
        (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))
  have hc :
      d.1.1.ofLp
          (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v)) =
        e.1.1.ofLp
          (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v)) := by
    exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hde) (G.connectedComponentMk v)
  exact hd.symm.trans (hc.trans he)

name: P3.componentConstantToKernel_surjective
statement:
theorem componentConstantToKernel_surjective
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (componentConstantToKernel (V := V) G)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  let x : VertexSpace V :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun v => a.1 (G.connectedComponentMk v))
  have hx0 : x ∈ DiagZero (V := V) := by
    change coordinateSum (V := V) x = 0
    rw [coordinateSum_apply]
    change (∑ v : V, a.1 (G.connectedComponentMk v)) = 0
    have ha := a.2
    change componentValueSum (V := V) G a.1 = 0 at ha
    exact ha
  let d0 : DiagZero (V := V) := ⟨x, hx0⟩
  have hd0 :
      d0 ∈ componentConstant (V := V) G := by
    rw [mem_componentConstant]
    intro i j hij
    change
      a.1 (G.connectedComponentMk i) =
        a.1 (G.connectedComponentMk j)
    rw [hij]
  let d : ↥(componentConstant (V := V) G) := ⟨d0, hd0⟩
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext c
  change
    a.1
        (G.connectedComponentMk
          (componentRep (V := V) G c)) =
      a.1 c
  rw [connectedComponentMk_componentRep (V := V) G c]

name: P3.finrank_componentConstant
statement:
theorem finrank_componentConstant
    [Nonempty V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(componentConstant (V := V) G) =
      componentCount (V := V) G - 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(componentConstant (V := V) G) =
        Module.finrank ℂ
          ↥(LinearMap.ker (componentValueSum (V := V) G)) :=
      (componentConstantKernelEquiv (V := V) G).finrank_eq
    _ = componentCount (V := V) G - 1 :=
      finrank_componentValueSum_ker (V := V) G

name: P3.silent_finrank_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem silent_finrank_of_graphSaturated
    [Nonempty V]
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(stabilizer (V := V) φ k) =
      componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_eq_componentConstant_of_graphSaturated
    (V := V) φ k hsat]
  exact
    finrank_componentConstant
      (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)

name: P3.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
statement:
theorem connectedComponentMk_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (f : EdgeSpace V) (hf : f ∈ hiddenFlow φ k)
    {i j : V}
    (hneq : edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j ≠ 0) :
    (supportGraph (V := V) φ k).connectedComponentMk i =
      (supportGraph (V := V) φ k).connectedComponentMk j

:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    intro h
    subst j
    exact hneq (edgeMatrix_diag (V := V) f i)
  exact
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
      (supportGraph_adj_of_flow (V := V) φ k f hf hij hneq)

name: P3.componentIndicator_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
statement:
theorem componentIndicator_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (f : EdgeSpace V) (hf : f ∈ hiddenFlow φ k)
    {i j : V}
    (hneq : edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j ≠ 0)
    (c : (supportGraph (V := V) φ k).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c i =
      componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c j
proof:
:= by
  apply componentIndicator_eq_of_mk_eq
  exact connectedComponentMk_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
    (V := V) φ k f hf hneq

name: P3.componentSum_divergence_eq_zero
statement:
theorem componentSum_divergence_eq_zero
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (f : EdgeSpace V) (hf : f ∈ hiddenFlow φ k) :
    componentSum (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
      (diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) (divergence (V := V) f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [componentSum_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  simp_rw [diagZeroCoordinates_apply, divergence_apply]
  simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

  have hswap :
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c i *
          edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i) =
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c j *
          edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) := by
    exact
      (Finset.sum_comm :
        (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
          componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c i *
            edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i) =
        ∑ j : V, ∑ i : V,
          componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c i *
            edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i)

  have heq :
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c i *
          edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) =
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V,
        componentIndicator (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) c j *
          edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    by_cases hzero : edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j = 0
    · simp [hzero]
    · rw [componentIndicator_eq_of_hiddenFlow_nonzero
        (V := V) φ k f hf hzero c]

  rw [hswap, heq]
  exact sub_self _

name: P3.divergence_mem_incidenceSpace
statement:
theorem divergence_mem_incidenceSpace
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (f : EdgeSpace V) (hf : f ∈ hiddenFlow φ k) :
    diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) (divergence (V := V) f) ∈
      incidenceSpace (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceSpace_eq_componentSum_ker (V := V)]
  change componentSum (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
      (diagZeroCoordinates (V := V) (divergence (V := V) f)) = 0
  exact componentSum_divergence_eq_zero (V := V) φ k f hf

name: P3.residueCoordinateSpace_le_incidenceSpace
statement:
theorem residueCoordinateSpace_le_incidenceSpace
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k ≤
      incidenceSpace (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  rw [residue_eq_map_divergence (V := V) φ k] at hr
  rcases hr with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact divergence_mem_incidenceSpace (V := V) φ k f hf

name: P3.diagonalSubmodule_le_closure

name: P3.closure_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closure_zero (φ : Dynamics V) :

proof:
:= by

    rintro x ⟨d, l, hl, rfl⟩

    hidden φ k ≤ closure φ k
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [offProjection_apply]
  exact (closure φ k).sub_mem hy
    (diagonalSubmodule_le_closure φ k
      (show delta (V := V) y ∈ diagonalSubmodule (V := V) from
        ⟨diagonalCoordinates (V := V) y, rfl⟩))

name: P3.hidden_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hidden_zero (φ : Dynamics V) :
    hidden φ 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hxD : x ∈ diagonalSubmodule (V := V) := by
      simpa [closure_zero] using hidden_le_closure (V := V) φ 0 hx
    have hxQ : x ∈ OffDiag (V := V) := hidden_le_OffDiag (V := V) φ 0 hx
    have hfix := delta_eq_self_of_mem_diagonalSubmodule (V := V) hxD
    change delta (V := V) x = 0 at hxQ
    rw [hfix] at hxQ
    simpa using hxQ
  · exact bot_le

name: P3.diagonal_disjoint_hidden
statement:
theorem diagonal_disjoint_hidden (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (diagonalSubmodule (V := V)) (hidden φ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hxD hxH
  have hfix := delta_eq_self_of_mem_diagonalSubmodule (V := V) hxD
  have hzero : delta (V := V) x = 0 := hidden_le_OffDiag (V := V) φ k hxH
  rw [hfix] at hzero
  exact hzero

name: P3.closure_eq_sup_diagonal_hidden
statement:
theorem closure_eq_sup_diagonal_hidden (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    closure φ k = diagonalSubmodule (V := V) ⊔ hidden φ k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [← delta_add_offProjection (V := V) x]
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left
        (show delta (V := V) x ∈ diagonalSubmodule (V := V) from
          ⟨diagonalCoordinates (V := V) x, rfl⟩)
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (show offProjection (V := V) x ∈ hidden φ k from
          ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · exact sup_le
      (diagonalSubmodule_le_closure φ k)
      (hidden_le_closure (V := V) φ k)

name: P3.hidden_eq_inf_ker
statement:
theorem hidden_eq_inf_ker (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    hidden φ k = closure φ k ⊓ OffDiag (V := V)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨hidden_le_closure (V := V) φ k hx,
      hidden_le_OffDiag (V := V) φ k hx⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hxM, hxK⟩
    change delta (V := V) x = 0 at hxK
    refine ⟨x, hxM, ?_⟩
    simp [offProjection, hxK]

name: P3.map_diagonal_mem_closure_one
statement:
theorem map_diagonal_mem_closure_one (φ : Dynamics V)
    (d : diagonalSubmodule (V := V)) :
    φ d.1 ∈ closure φ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨d, 1, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  simp

name: P3.closure_succ
statement:
theorem closure_succ (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    closure φ (k + 1) =
      diagonalSubmodule (V := V) ⊔ (closure φ k).map φ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨d, l, hl, rfl⟩
    cases l with
    | zero =>
        exact Submodule.mem_sup_left d.property
    | succ l =>
        have hlk : l ≤ k := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hl
        apply Submodule.mem_sup_right
        refine ⟨(φ ^ l) d.1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply Submodule.subset_span
          exact ⟨d, l, hlk, rfl⟩
        · simp [pow_succ']
  · apply sup_le
    · exact diagonalSubmodule_le_closure φ (k + 1)
    · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro x ⟨d, l, hl, rfl⟩
      change φ ((φ ^ l) d.1) ∈ closure φ (k + 1)
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      refine ⟨d, l + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ hl, ?_⟩
      simp [pow_succ']

name: P3.closure_one_eq_diagonal_of_preservesDiagonal
statement:
theorem closure_one_eq_diagonal_of_preservesDiagonal (φ : Dynamics V)
    (hφ : PreservesDiagonal (V := V) φ) :
    closure φ 1 = diagonalSubmodule (V := V)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨d, l, hl, rfl⟩
    cases l with
    | zero => simp
    | succ l =>
        have hl0 : l = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hl)
        subst l
        simpa using hφ d
  · exact diagonalSubmodule_le_closure φ 1

name: P3.closure_eq_diagonal_iff_hidden_eq_bot
statement:
theorem closure_eq_diagonal_iff_hidden_eq_bot (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    closure φ k = diagonalSubmodule (V := V) ↔ hidden φ k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hM
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hxH
      have hxD : x ∈ diagonalSubmodule (V := V) := by
        rw [← hM]
        exact hidden_le_closure (V := V) φ k hxH
      have hfix := delta_eq_self_of_mem_diagonalSubmodule (V := V) hxD
      have hzero : delta (V := V) x = 0 :=
        hidden_le_OffDiag (V := V) φ k hxH
      rw [hfix] at hzero
      exact hzero
    · exact bot_le
  · intro hH
    rw [closure_eq_sup_diagonal_hidden (V := V) φ k, hH, sup_bot_eq]

name: P3.preservesDiagonal_iff_hidden_one_eq_bot
statement:
theorem preservesDiagonal_iff_hidden_one_eq_bot (φ : Dynamics V) :
    PreservesDiagonal (V := V) φ ↔ hidden φ 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hφ
    exact (closure_eq_diagonal_iff_hidden_eq_bot (V := V) φ 1).1
      (closure_one_eq_diagonal_of_preservesDiagonal (V := V) φ hφ)
  · intro hH d
    have hQmem : offProjection (V := V) (φ d.1) ∈ hidden φ 1 :=
      ⟨φ d.1, map_diagonal_mem_closure_one (V := V) φ d, rfl⟩
    have hQzero : offProjection (V := V) (φ d.1) = 0 := by
      have : offProjection (V := V) (φ d.1) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ (A V)) := by
        rw [← hH]
        exact hQmem
      simpa using this
    rw [offProjection_apply] at hQzero
    have hdiag : φ d.1 = delta (V := V) (φ d.1) := sub_eq_zero.mp hQzero
    rw [hdiag]
    exact ⟨diagonalCoordinates (V := V) (φ d.1), rfl⟩

name: P3.noninvariant_iff_hidden_one_ne_bot
statement:
theorem noninvariant_iff_hidden_one_ne_bot (φ : Dynamics V) :
    (¬ PreservesDiagonal (V := V) φ) ↔ hidden φ 1 ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  exact not_congr (preservesDiagonal_iff_hidden_one_eq_bot (V := V) φ)

name: P3.diagonal_lt_closure_iff_hidden_ne_bot
statement:
theorem diagonal_lt_closure_iff_hidden_ne_bot (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    diagonalSubmodule (V := V) < closure φ k ↔ hidden φ k ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hlt hH
    have hEq : closure φ k = diagonalSubmodule (V := V) :=
      (closure_eq_diagonal_iff_hidden_eq_bot (V := V) φ k).2 hH
    rw [hEq] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)
  · intro hH
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (diagonalSubmodule_le_closure φ k) ?_
    intro hEq
    apply hH
    apply (closure_eq_diagonal_iff_hidden_eq_bot (V := V) φ k).1
    exact hEq.symm

name: P3.closure_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem closure_eventually_constant (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → closure φ k = closure φ s
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ →o Submodule ℂ (A V) := closureOrderHom (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := WellFoundedGT.monotone_chain_condition a
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro k hsk
  exact (hs k hsk).symm

name: P3.closure_invariant_of_succ_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hmap : (closure φ s).map φ ≤ closure φ (s + 1) := by
    rw [closure_succ]
    exact le_sup_right
  have hxmap : φ x ∈ (closure φ s).map φ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hxnext : φ x ∈ closure φ (s + 1) := hmap hxmap
  rw [hstable] at hxnext
  exact hxnext

name: P3.closure_le_of_diagonal_le_of_invariant
statement:
theorem closure_le_of_diagonal_le_of_invariant (φ : Dynamics V)
    (S : Submodule ℂ (A V))
    (hD : diagonalSubmodule (V := V) ≤ S)
    (hInv : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x ∈ S)
    (k : ℕ) :
    closure φ k ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨d, l, hl, rfl⟩
  have hiter : ∀ n : ℕ, (φ ^ n) d.1 ∈ S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simpa using hD d.property
    | succ n ih =>
        simpa [pow_succ'] using hInv ((φ ^ n) d.1) ih
  exact hiter l

name: P3.exists_stable_invariant_closure
statement:
theorem exists_stable_invariant_closure (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → closure φ k = closure φ s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ closure φ s, φ x ∈ closure φ s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := closure_eventually_constant (V := V) φ
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  apply closure_invariant_of_succ_eq (V := V) φ
  exact hs (s + 1) (Nat.le_succ s)

name: P3.stable_closure_minimal
statement:
theorem stable_closure_minimal (φ : Dynamics V) {s : ℕ}
    (S : Submodule ℂ (A V))
    (hD : diagonalSubmodule (V := V) ≤ S)
    (hInv : ∀ x ∈ S, φ x ∈ S) :
    closure φ s ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  exact closure_le_of_diagonal_le_of_invariant (V := V) φ S hD hInv s

name: P3.primitiveReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan
statement:
theorem primitiveReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan
    (φ : Dynamics V) {k m n : ℕ}
    (hmn : m + n ≤ k)
    (d e : diagonalSubmodule (V := V)) :
    quadraticReturn (V := V)
        (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d)
        (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e)
      ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨m, n, hmn, d, e, rfl⟩

name: P3.offDiagOfPrimitiveSpan_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem offDiagOfPrimitiveSpan_val
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (x : A V) (hx : x ∈ primitiveHiddenSpan (V := V) φ k) :
    (offDiagOfPrimitiveSpan (V := V) φ k x hx).1 = x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.quadraticReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan_of_mem
statement:
theorem quadraticReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan_of_mem
    (φ : Dynamics V) {i j k : ℕ} (hij : i + j ≤ k)
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V))
    (hz : z.1 ∈ primitiveHiddenSpan (V := V) φ i)
    (hw : w.1 ∈ primitiveHiddenSpan (V := V) φ j) :
    quadraticReturn (V := V) z w
      ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (A V) :=
    {x | ∃ d : diagonalSubmodule (V := V), ∃ m : ℕ,
      m ≤ i ∧ (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d).1 = x}
  let T : Set (A V) :=
    {y | ∃ e : diagonalSubmodule (V := V), ∃ n : ℕ,
      n ≤ j ∧ (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e).1 = y}

  have hzspan : z.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S := by
    simpa [S, primitiveHiddenSpan] using hz
  have hwspan : w.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T := by
    simpa [T, primitiveHiddenSpan] using hw

  let packS :
      (x : A V) → x ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S → OffDiag (V := V) :=
    fun x hx =>
      offDiagOfPrimitiveSpan (V := V) φ i x
        (by simpa [S, primitiveHiddenSpan] using hx)
  let packT :
      (y : A V) → y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T → OffDiag (V := V) :=
    fun y hy =>
      offDiagOfPrimitiveSpan (V := V) φ j y
        (by simpa [T, primitiveHiddenSpan] using hy)

  let P :
      (x y : A V) →
      x ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S →
      y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T → Prop :=
    fun x y hx hy =>
      quadraticReturn (V := V) (packS x hx) (packT y hy)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k

  have hP : P z.1 w.1 hzspan hwspan := by
    refine Submodule.span_induction₂
      (s := S) (t := T) (p := P) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hzspan hwspan
    · intro x y hx hy
      rcases hx with ⟨d, m, hmi, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨e, n, hnj, rfl⟩
      have hmn : m + n ≤ k := by omega
      have hS :
          (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d).1 ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S :=
        Submodule.subset_span
          (show (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d).1 ∈ S from
            ⟨d, m, hmi, rfl⟩)
      have hT :
          (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e).1 ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T :=
        Submodule.subset_span
          (show (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e).1 ∈ T from
            ⟨e, n, hnj, rfl⟩)
      have hpackS :
          packS (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d).1 hS =
            primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      have hpackT :
          packT (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e).1 hT =
            primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d).1 hS)
          (packT (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e).1 hT)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      rw [hpackS, hpackT]
      exact primitiveReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan
        (V := V) φ hmn d e
    · intro y hy
      have h0S : (0 : A V) ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S :=
        Submodule.zero_mem _
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS 0 h0S) (packT y hy)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      have hzero : packS 0 h0S = (0 : OffDiag (V := V)) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hzero, quadraticReturn_zero_left]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · intro x hx
      have h0T : (0 : A V) ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T :=
        Submodule.zero_mem _
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS x hx) (packT 0 h0T)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      have hzero : packT 0 h0T = (0 : OffDiag (V := V)) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hzero, quadraticReturn_zero_right]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · intro x y q hx hy hq hxy hqy
      have hsumS : x + y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S :=
        (Submodule.span ℂ S).add_mem hx hy
      have hpack :
          packS (x + y) hsumS = packS x hx + packS y hy := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS (x + y) hsumS) (packT q hq)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      rw [hpack, quadraticReturn_add_left]
      exact (primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k).add_mem hxy hqy
    · intro x y q hx hy hq hxy hxq
      have hsumT : y + q ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T :=
        (Submodule.span ℂ T).add_mem hy hq
      have hpack :
          packT (y + q) hsumT = packT y hy + packT q hq := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS x hx) (packT (y + q) hsumT)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      rw [hpack, quadraticReturn_add_right]
      exact (primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k).add_mem hxy hxq
    · intro c x y hx hy hxy
      have hsmulS : c • x ∈ Submodule.span ℂ S :=
        (Submodule.span ℂ S).smul_mem c hx
      have hpack :
          packS (c • x) hsmulS = c • packS x hx := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS (c • x) hsmulS) (packT y hy)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      rw [hpack, quadraticReturn_smul_left]
      exact (primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k).smul_mem c hxy
    · intro c x y hx hy hxy
      have hsmulT : c • y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ T :=
        (Submodule.span ℂ T).smul_mem c hy
      have hpack :
          packT (c • y) hsmulT = c • packT y hy := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      change quadraticReturn (V := V)
          (packS x hx) (packT (c • y) hsmulT)
        ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
      rw [hpack, quadraticReturn_smul_right]
      exact (primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k).smul_mem (star c) hxy

  have hzpack : packS z.1 hzspan = z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hwpack : packT w.1 hwspan = w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  change quadraticReturn (V := V)
      (packS z.1 hzspan) (packT w.1 hwspan)
    ∈ primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k at hP
  simpa [hzpack, hwpack] using hP

name: P3.residue_eq_span_primitive
statement:
theorem residue_eq_span_primitive
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    residue φ k = primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro r hr
    rcases hr with ⟨i, j, hij, z, w, hz, hw, rfl⟩
    apply quadraticReturn_mem_primitiveResidueSpan_of_mem
      (V := V) φ hij z w
    · rw [← hidden_eq_span_primitive (V := V) φ i]
      exact hz
    · rw [← hidden_eq_span_primitive (V := V) φ j]
      exact hw
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro r hr
    rcases hr with ⟨m, n, hmn, d, e, rfl⟩
    exact quadraticReturn_mem_residue
      (V := V) φ hmn
      (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ m d)
      (primitiveDefect (V := V) φ n e)
      (primitiveDefect_mem_hidden (V := V) φ le_rfl d)
      (primitiveDefect_mem_hidden (V := V) φ le_rfl e)

name: P3.hidden_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem hidden_eventually_constant (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → hidden φ k = hidden φ s
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ →o Submodule ℂ (A V) := hiddenOrderHom (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := WellFoundedGT.monotone_chain_condition a
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro k hsk
  exact (hs k hsk).symm

name: P3.hiddenFlow_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem hiddenFlow_eventually_constant (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → hiddenFlow φ k = hiddenFlow φ s
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ →o Submodule ℂ (EdgeSpace V) := hiddenFlowOrderHom (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := WellFoundedGT.monotone_chain_condition a
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro k hsk
  exact (hs k hsk).symm

name: P3.residue_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem residue_eventually_constant (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → residue φ k = residue φ s
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ →o Submodule ℂ (DiagZero (V := V)) := residueOrderHom (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := WellFoundedGT.monotone_chain_condition a
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro k hsk
  exact (hs k hsk).symm

name: P3.finite_core_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem finite_core_eventually_constant (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k →
      hidden φ k = hidden φ s ∧
      hiddenFlow φ k = hiddenFlow φ s ∧
      residue φ k = residue φ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sH, hH⟩ := hidden_eventually_constant (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨sF, hF⟩ := hiddenFlow_eventually_constant (V := V) φ
  obtain ⟨sR, hR⟩ := residue_eventually_constant (V := V) φ
  let s := max sH (max sF sR)
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro k hsk
  have hsH : sH ≤ s := by
    exact le_max_left _ _
  have hsF : sF ≤ s := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hsR : sR ≤ s := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hkH : sH ≤ k := hsH.trans hsk
  have hkF : sF ≤ k := hsF.trans hsk
  have hkR : sR ≤ k := hsR.trans hsk
  constructor
  · calc
      hidden φ k = hidden φ sH := hH k hkH
      _ = hidden φ s := (hH s hsH).symm
  constructor
  · calc
      hiddenFlow φ k = hiddenFlow φ sF := hF k hkF
      _ = hiddenFlow φ s := (hF s hsF).symm
  · calc
      residue φ k = residue φ sR := hR k hkR
      _ = residue φ s := (hR s hsR).symm

name: P3.closureDim_add_growth
statement:
theorem closureDim_add_growth (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    closureDim φ k + closureGrowth φ (k + 1) =
      closureDim φ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  change closureDim φ k +
      (closureDim φ (k + 1) - closureDim φ k) =
    closureDim φ (k + 1)
  exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (closureDim_mono φ (Nat.le_succ k))

name: P3.residueGrowth_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem residueGrowth_one (φ : Dynamics V) :
    residueGrowth φ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank ℂ (residue φ 1) -
      Module.finrank ℂ (residue φ 0) = 0
  rw [residue_one (V := V) φ, residue_zero (V := V) φ]
  simp

name: P3.residueGrowth_eq_zero_of_stable
statement:
theorem residueGrowth_eq_zero_of_stable
    (φ : Dynamics V) {s k : ℕ}
    (hsk : s ≤ k)
    (hstable : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≤ n → residue φ n = residue φ s) :
    residueGrowth φ (k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank ℂ (residue φ (k + 1)) -
      Module.finrank ℂ (residue φ k) = 0
  have hk : residue φ k = residue φ s := hstable k hsk
  have hks : s ≤ k + 1 := hsk.trans (Nat.le_succ k)
  have hsucc : residue φ (k + 1) = residue φ s :=
    hstable (k + 1) hks
  rw [hsucc, hk]
  simp

name: P3.CRP_residue_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem CRP_residue_eventually_zero (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → residueGrowth φ (k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := residue_eventually_constant (V := V) φ
  exact ⟨s, fun k hsk =>
    residueGrowth_eq_zero_of_stable (V := V) φ hsk hs⟩

name: P3.residue_eq_map_divergence
statement:
theorem residue_eq_map_divergence (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    residue φ k = (hiddenFlow φ k).map (divergence (V := V))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro r hr
    rcases hr with ⟨i, j, hij, z, w, hz, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [quadraticReturn_eq_divergence (V := V) z w]
    exact ⟨hadamardFlow (V := V) z w,
      hadamardFlow_mem_hiddenFlow (V := V) φ hij z w hz hw, rfl⟩
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    rcases hf with ⟨i, j, hij, z, w, hz, hw, rfl⟩
    change divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w) ∈ residue φ k
    rw [← quadraticReturn_eq_divergence (V := V) z w]
    exact quadraticReturn_mem_residue (V := V) φ hij z w hz hw

  simp [coordinateSum_apply, x, v0]

name: P3.diagonalSubmodule_finrank
statement:
theorem diagonalSubmodule_finrank :
    Module.finrank ℂ (diagonalSubmodule (V := V)) = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank ℂ (diagonalSubmodule (V := V))
        = Module.finrank ℂ (VertexSpace V) :=
          (diagonalEmbeddingEquiv (V := V)).finrank_eq.symm
    _ = Fintype.card V := finrank_euclideanSpace

name: P3.diagZero_finrank
statement:
theorem diagZero_finrank [Nonempty V] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (DiagZero (V := V)) = Fintype.card V - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (coordinateSum (V := V)) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (coordinateSum_surjective (V := V))
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (coordinateSum (V := V))
  rw [hrange, finrank_top, CommSemiring.finrank_self, finrank_euclideanSpace] at h
  have hdim :
      1 + Module.finrank ℂ (DiagZero (V := V)) = Fintype.card V := h
  exact Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq' hdim

name: P3.diagonalTracelessSubmodule_finrank

proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank ℂ (diagonalTracelessSubmodule (V := V))
        = Module.finrank ℂ (DiagZero (V := V)) :=
          (diagZeroEquiv (V := V)).finrank_eq.symm
    _ = Fintype.card V - 1 := diagZero_finrank (V := V)

name: P3.diagZeroCoordinates_injective
statement:

name: P3.residueCoordinateMap_injective

name: P3.graphSaturated_iff
statement:
theorem graphSaturated_iff
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ) :
    graphSaturated (V := V) φ k ↔
      residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k =
        incidenceSpace (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:

name: P3.finrank_residue_eq_card_sub_componentCount_of_graphSaturated
statement:
theorem finrank_residue_eq_card_sub_componentCount_of_graphSaturated
    (φ : Dynamics V) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := V) φ k) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residue φ k) =
      Fintype.card V -
        componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord :
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k) =
        Fintype.card V -
          componentCount (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k) := by
    rw [hsat]
    exact incidence_rank (V := V) (supportGraph (V := V) φ k)
  rw [finrank_residueCoordinateSpace (V := V) φ k] at hcoord
  exact hcoord

name: P3.residue_le_stableResidue

name: P3.stableResidue_eq_of_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem stableResidue_eq_of_eventually_constant
    (φ : Dynamics V) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → residue φ k = residue φ s) :
    stableResidue (V := V) φ = residue φ s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    rcases le_total k s with hks | hsk
    · exact residue_mono φ hks
    · rw [hs k hsk]
  · exact residue_le_stableResidue (V := V) φ s

name: P3.stableHiddenFlow_eq_of_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem stableHiddenFlow_eq_of_eventually_constant
    (φ : Dynamics V) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ k : ℕ, s ≤ k → hiddenFlow φ k = hiddenFlow φ s) :
    stableHiddenFlow (V := V) φ = hiddenFlow φ s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    rcases le_total k s with hks | hsk
    · exact hiddenFlow_mono φ hks
    · rw [hs k hsk]
  · exact hiddenFlow_le_stableHiddenFlow (V := V) φ s

name: P3.coreStabilizationDepth_spec
statement:
theorem coreStabilizationDepth_spec
    (φ : Dynamics V) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ ≤ k →
      hidden φ k =
          hidden φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ) ∧
      hiddenFlow φ k =
          hiddenFlow φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ) ∧
      residue φ k =
          residue φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    (finite_core_eventually_constant (V := V) φ)

name: P3.stableResidue_eq_core
statement:
theorem stableResidue_eq_core
    (φ : Dynamics V) :
    stableResidue (V := V) φ =
      residue φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply stableResidue_eq_of_eventually_constant
  intro k hk
  exact (coreStabilizationDepth_spec (V := V) φ k hk).2.2

name: P3.stableHiddenFlow_eq_core

name: P3.graphSaturatedAtInfinity_iff_core
statement:

    (φ : Dynamics V) :
    graphSaturatedAtInfinity (V := V) φ ↔
      graphSaturated (V := V) φ
        (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphSaturatedAtInfinity stableResidueCoordinateSpace
    stableSupportGraph graphSaturated residueCoordinateSpace

name: P3.QDMR_eq_core_residue_finrank
statement:

    (φ : Dynamics V) :
    QDMR (V := V) φ =

        ↥(residue φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold QDMR
  rw [stableResidue_eq_core (V := V) φ]

name: P3.QDMR_eq_card_sub_components
statement:
theorem QDMR_eq_card_sub_components
    (φ : Dynamics V)
    (hsat : graphSaturatedAtInfinity (V := V) φ) :
    QDMR (V := V) φ =
      Fintype.card V -
        componentCount (V := V) (stableSupportGraph (V := V) φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [QDMR_eq_core_residue_finrank (V := V) φ]
  unfold stableSupportGraph
  exact residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated
    (V := V) φ (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ)
    ((graphSaturatedAtInfinity_iff_core (V := V) φ).mp hsat)

name: P3.stableResidue_eq_stablePrimitiveResidueSpan
statement:

    (φ : Dynamics V) :
    stableResidue (V := V) φ =
      stablePrimitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    rw [residue_eq_span_primitive (V := V) φ k]
    exact le_iSup
      (fun n : ℕ => primitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ n) k
  · apply iSup_le
    intro k
    rw [← residue_eq_span_primitive (V := V) φ k]
    exact le_iSup
      (fun n : ℕ => residue φ n) k

statement:

    (φ : Dynamics V) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [← stableResidue_eq_stablePrimitiveResidueSpan (V := V) φ,
      stableResidue_eq_core (V := V) φ,
      residue_eq_span_primitive (V := V) φ
        (coreStabilizationDepth (V := V) φ)]

    (φ : Dynamics V) :

name: P3.QDMR_eq_core_primitiveResidue_finrank
statement:
theorem QDMR_eq_core_primitiveResidue_finrank

      stablePrimitiveResidueSpan_eq_core (V := V) φ]

name: P3.dynamicCoefficient_identity
statement:
theorem dynamicCoefficient_identity
    (s : ℂ) (hs : star s = s) :
    dynamicC1 s * star dynamicC2 -
        star (dynamicC1 s) * dynamicC2 =
      -(8 / 9 : ℂ) * Complex.I * s
proof:
:= by
  simp [dynamicC1, dynamicC2, hs]

proof:

    sqrtThreeC ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Real.sqrt (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  intro h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  change Real.sqrt (3 : ℝ) = 0 at hre
  exact hR hre

        star (dynamicC1 sqrtThreeC) * dynamicC2 ≠ 0

  exact mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Complex.I_ne_zero)
    sqrtThreeC_ne_zero

name: P3.primitiveDefect_dynamicPhiCore_one
statement:

    primitiveDefect (V := Two) dynamicPhiCore 1 dynamicHDiagonal =

:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [primitiveDefect_val]
  simp only [pow_one, dynamicHDiagonal]
  rw [dynamicPhiCore_h]
  rw [map_add, map_smul]
  have hh :
      offProjection (V := Two) dynamicHMatrix = 0 := by
    change dynamicHMatrix - delta (V := Two) dynamicHMatrix = 0
    rw [delta_dynamicHMatrix]
    simp
  have hz :
      offProjection (V := Two) dynamicZ1.1 = dynamicZ1.1 := by
    change dynamicZ1.1 - delta (V := Two) dynamicZ1.1 = dynamicZ1.1
    rw [dynamicZ1.2]

  rw [hh, hz]
  simp

  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [dynamicPhiCore, dynamicPhiCoreMatrix,
      dynamicHMatrix, dynamicHCoordinates,
      diagonalEmbedding_apply, dynamicZ1, dynamicZ2,
      hermitianOff, hermitianOffMatrix,

name: P3.primitiveReturn_dynamicPhiCore_le_two_zero
statement:
theorem primitiveReturn_dynamicPhiCore_le_two_zero
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m + n ≤ 2)
    (d e : diagonalSubmodule (V := Two)) :
    quadraticReturn (V := Two)
        (primitiveDefect (V := Two) dynamicPhiCore m d)
        (primitiveDefect (V := Two) dynamicPhiCore n e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm0 : m = 0
  · subst m
    rw [primitiveDefect_dynamicPhiCore_zero]
    simp
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    rw [primitiveDefect_dynamicPhiCore_zero]
    simp
  have hm1 : m = 1 := by omega
  have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
  subst m
  subst n
  rw [primitiveDefect_dynamicPhiCore_one_general,
      primitiveDefect_dynamicPhiCore_one_general,
      quadraticReturn_smul_left,
      quadraticReturn_smul_right,
      quadraticReturn_dynamicZ1_self_zero]

    intro r hr
    rcases hr with ⟨m, n, hmn, d, e, rfl⟩

name: P3.normedExp_dynamicAlpha
statement:
theorem normedExp_dynamicAlpha :
    NormedSpace.exp dynamicAlpha =
      dynamicA - Complex.I * dynamicA
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
  rw [show dynamicAlpha =
      ((dynamicTheta : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by rfl]
  rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  simp only [dynamicTheta, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg,
    Real.cos_pi_div_four, Real.sin_pi_div_four]
  have hhalf :
      (((Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = sqrtTwoC / 2 := by
    simp [sqrtTwoC]
  have hnegHalf :
      (((-(Real.sqrt 2 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = -(sqrtTwoC / 2) := by
    simp [sqrtTwoC]
  rw [hhalf, hnegHalf, sqrtTwoC_div_two_eq_dynamicA]
  ring

      dynamicA + Complex.I * dynamicA
proof:

  have harg :
      -dynamicAlpha =
        ((Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    simp [dynamicAlpha, dynamicTheta]
  rw [harg, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  rw [Real.cos_pi_div_four, Real.sin_pi_div_four]
  have hhalf :
      (((Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = sqrtTwoC / 2 := by
    simp [sqrtTwoC]
  rw [hhalf, sqrtTwoC_div_two_eq_dynamicA]
  ring

    dynamicExponentMatrix =
      (↑dynamicVUnit : A Two) *

        (↑(dynamicVUnit⁻¹) : A Two)
proof:
:= by
  change (dynamicAlpha / sqrtThreeC) • dynamicK =
    dynamicV * (dynamicAlpha • dynamicHMatrix) * dynamicVInv
  rw [dynamicK_eq_conj_diagonal]
  have hs :
      (dynamicAlpha / sqrtThreeC) * sqrtThreeC = dynamicAlpha := by

name: P3.dynamicV_conj_exp_h_eq_paperClosed
statement:
theorem dynamicV_conj_exp_h_eq_paperClosed :
    dynamicV *
        NormedSpace.exp (dynamicAlpha • dynamicHMatrix) *
        dynamicVInv =
      dynamicUPaperClosed
proof:
:= by
  rw [normedExp_dynamicAlpha_h]
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  have hVone :
      dynamicV * (1 : A Two) * dynamicVInv = (1 : A Two) := by
    simpa using dynamicV_mul_inv
  rw [hVone, dynamicV_conj_h]
  rw [dynamicUPaperClosed]
  simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul]
  have hcoef :
      Complex.I * dynamicA * (1 / sqrtThreeC) =
        dynamicA * (Complex.I / sqrtThreeC) := by
    ring
  rw [hcoef]

:= by

      (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ k hsat,
    hsupport,
    longPathGraph_componentCount]
  simp

name: P3.longPath_QDMR_eq
statement:
theorem longPath_QDMR_eq
    (n : ℕ) (φ : Dynamics (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hsat : graphSaturatedAtInfinity (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ)
    (hsupport :
      stableSupportGraph (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ = longPathGraph n) :
    QDMR (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [QDMR_eq_card_sub_components
      (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ hsat,
    hsupport,
    longPathGraph_componentCount]
  simp

name: P3.finiteLongPathConclusion
statement:
theorem finiteLongPathConclusion
    (n : ℕ) (φ : Dynamics (Fin (n + 1))) (k : ℕ)
    (hsat : graphSaturated (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ k)
    (hsupport :
      supportGraph (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ k = longPathGraph n) :
    stabilizer (V := Fin (n + 1)) φ k = ⊥ ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(residue φ k) = n
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨
    longPath_stabilizer_eq_bot_of_graphSaturated n φ k hsat hsupport,
    longPath_residue_finrank_of_graphSaturated n φ k hsat hsupport
  ⟩

name: P3.offDiagToEdge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem offDiagToEdge_apply (z : OffDiag (V := V)) (e : Edge V) :

name: P3.offDiag_diag_zero

name: P3.edgeMatrix_diag

@[simp]
theorem edgeMatrix_diag (f : EdgeSpace V) (i : V) :

name: P3.delta_edgeMatrix_zero

name: P3.edgeToOffDiag_offdiag_apply

name: P3.edgeToOffDiag_diag_apply

theorem edgeToOffDiag_diag_apply (f : EdgeSpace V) (i : V) :

name: P3.hadamardFlow_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hadamardFlow_apply (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) (e : Edge V) :
    (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w).ofLp e =
      z.1 e.1.1 e.1.2 * star (w.1 e.1.1 e.1.2)
proof:

name: P3.hadamardFlow_add_left
statement:
theorem hadamardFlow_add_left (z₁ z₂ w : OffDiag (V := V)) :

      hadamardFlow (V := V) z₁ w + hadamardFlow (V := V) z₂ w
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Edge V → ℂ)).injective

name: P3.hadamardFlow_smul_left
statement:
theorem hadamardFlow_smul_left (c : ℂ) (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    hadamardFlow (V := V) (c • z) w =
      c • hadamardFlow (V := V) z w
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Edge V → ℂ)).injective

name: P3.hadamardFlow_add_right
statement:
theorem hadamardFlow_add_right (z w₁ w₂ : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    hadamardFlow (V := V) z (w₁ + w₂) =

proof:
:= by

name: P3.hadamardFlow_smul_right
statement:
theorem hadamardFlow_smul_right (c : ℂ) (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    hadamardFlow (V := V) z (c • w) =

proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Edge V → ℂ)).injective
  ext e
  simp [hadamardFlow, mul_left_comm]

name: P3.divergenceRaw_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divergenceRaw_apply (f : EdgeSpace V) (i : V) :
    (divergenceRaw (V := V) f).ofLp i =
      (∑ j, edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) -
      (∑ j, edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.coordinateSum_divergenceRaw
statement:
theorem coordinateSum_divergenceRaw (f : EdgeSpace V) :
    coordinateSum (V := V) (divergenceRaw (V := V) f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSum_apply]
  simp only [divergenceRaw_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hswap :
      (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V, edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i) =
        ∑ i : V, ∑ j : V, edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j := by
    simpa using
      (Finset.sum_comm :
        (∑ i : V, ∑ j : V, edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) =
          ∑ j : V, ∑ i : V, edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j).symm
  rw [hswap]
  exact sub_self _

name: P3.divergence_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divergence_apply (f : EdgeSpace V) (i : V) :
    ((divergence (V := V) f).1).ofLp i =
      (∑ j, edgeMatrix (V := V) f i j) -
      (∑ j, edgeMatrix (V := V) f j i)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.edgeMatrix_hadamardFlow_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeMatrix_hadamardFlow_apply
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) (i j : V) :
    edgeMatrix (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w) i j =
      z.1 i j * star (w.1 i j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [edgeMatrix, offDiag_diag_zero]
  · simp [edgeMatrix, h, hadamardFlow_apply]

name: P3.divergence_hadamardFlow_apply
statement:
theorem divergence_hadamardFlow_apply
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) (i : V) :
    ((divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w)).1).ofLp i =
      (∑ j, z.1 i j * star (w.1 i j)) -
      (∑ j, z.1 j i * star (w.1 j i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [divergence_apply]
  simp_rw [edgeMatrix_hadamardFlow_apply]

name: P3.commutator_conjTranspose_diagonal_entry
statement:
theorem commutator_conjTranspose_diagonal_entry
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) (i : V) :
    (z.1 * w.1.conjTranspose - w.1.conjTranspose * z.1) i i =
      (∑ j, z.1 i j * star (w.1 i j)) -
      (∑ j, z.1 j i * star (w.1 j i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, mul_comm]

name: P3.quadraticReturn_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quadraticReturn_apply
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) (i : V) :
    ((quadraticReturn (V := V) z w).1).ofLp i =
      (z.1 * w.1.conjTranspose - w.1.conjTranspose * z.1) i i
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.quadraticReturn_eq_divergence
statement:
theorem quadraticReturn_eq_divergence
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    quadraticReturn (V := V) z w =
      divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (vertexEquiv (V := V)).injective
  ext i
  change
    ((quadraticReturn (V := V) z w).1).ofLp i =
      ((divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w)).1).ofLp i
  rw [quadraticReturn_apply, divergence_hadamardFlow_apply]
  exact commutator_conjTranspose_diagonal_entry (V := V) z w i

name: P3.diagonalEmbedding_quadraticReturn
statement:
theorem diagonalEmbedding_quadraticReturn
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    diagonalEmbedding (V := V) (quadraticReturn (V := V) z w).1 =
      delta (V := V)
        (z.1 * w.1.conjTranspose - w.1.conjTranspose * z.1)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [diagonalEmbedding_apply, delta_apply, quadraticReturn_apply]
  · simp [diagonalEmbedding_apply, delta_apply, h]

name: P3.flowResidueFactorization
statement:
theorem flowResidueFactorization
    (z w : OffDiag (V := V)) :
    delta (V := V)
        (z.1 * w.1.conjTranspose - w.1.conjTranspose * z.1) =
      diagonalEmbedding (V := V)
        (divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z w)).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← quadraticReturn_eq_divergence (V := V) z w]
  exact (diagonalEmbedding_quadraticReturn (V := V) z w).symm

name: P3.quadraticReturn_self_entry
statement:
theorem quadraticReturn_self_entry
    (z : OffDiag (V := V)) (i : V) :
    ((quadraticReturn (V := V) z z).1).ofLp i =
      (∑ j, z.1 i j * star (z.1 i j)) -
      (∑ j, z.1 j i * star (z.1 j i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticReturn_apply]
  exact commutator_conjTranspose_diagonal_entry (V := V) z z i

name: P3.divergence_self_hadamard_entry
statement:
theorem divergence_self_hadamard_entry
    (z : OffDiag (V := V)) (i : V) :
    ((divergence (V := V) (hadamardFlow (V := V) z z)).1).ofLp i =
      (∑ j, z.1 i j * star (z.1 i j)) -
      (∑ j, z.1 j i * star (z.1 j i))
proof:
:= by
  exact divergence_hadamardFlow_apply (V := V) z z i

name: P3.edgeDifference_apply
statement:

name: P3.edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace
statement:
theorem edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    edgeDifference (V := V) u v ∈ incidenceSpace (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩

name: P3.mem_graphZeroSumSpace
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_graphZeroSumSpace (x : GraphVertexSpace V) :
    x ∈ graphZeroSumSpace (V := V) ↔ ∑ v : V, x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.edgeDifference_mem_graphZeroSumSpace
statement:
theorem edgeDifference_mem_graphZeroSumSpace (u v : V) :
    edgeDifference (V := V) u v ∈ graphZeroSumSpace (V := V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_graphZeroSumSpace]
  simp [edgeDifference, vertexDelta, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: P3.incidenceSpace_le_graphZeroSumSpace
statement:
theorem incidenceSpace_le_graphZeroSumSpace (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    incidenceSpace (V := V) G ≤ graphZeroSumSpace (V := V)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩
  exact edgeDifference_mem_graphZeroSumSpace (V := V) u v

name: P3.edgeDifference_trans
statement:
theorem edgeDifference_trans
    (u v w : V) :
    edgeDifference (V := V) u w =
      edgeDifference (V := V) u v +
        edgeDifference (V := V) v w
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [edgeDifference, vertexDelta]

name: P3.edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_reachable
statement:
theorem edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_reachable
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V} (huv : G.Reachable u v) :
    edgeDifference (V := V) u v ∈ incidenceSpace (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  have hrt : Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj u v :=
    (SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen (G := G) u v).mp huv
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.trans_induction_on
    (motive := fun {a b} _ =>
      edgeDifference (V := V) a b ∈ incidenceSpace (V := V) G)
    hrt ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a
    rw [edgeDifference_self]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro a b hab
    exact edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace (V := V) G hab
  · intro a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc
    rw [edgeDifference_trans]
    exact (incidenceSpace (V := V) G).add_mem ihab ihbc

name: P3.edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_component_eq
statement:
theorem edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_component_eq
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V}
    (hcomp : G.connectedComponentMk u = G.connectedComponentMk v) :
    edgeDifference (V := V) u v ∈ incidenceSpace (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  apply edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_reachable (V := V) G
  exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact hcomp

name: P3.componentIndicator_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentIndicator_self
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) :
    componentIndicator (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk u) u = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [componentIndicator]

name: P3.componentIndicator_eq_of_mk_eq
statement:
theorem componentIndicator_eq_of_mk_eq
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V}
    (h : G.connectedComponentMk u = G.connectedComponentMk v)
    (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    componentIndicator (V := V) G c u =
      componentIndicator (V := V) G c v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [componentIndicator, h]

name: P3.componentSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentSum_apply
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : GraphVertexSpace V)
    (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    componentSum (V := V) G x c =
      ∑ v : V, componentIndicator (V := V) G c v * x v
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P3.componentSum_vertexDelta
statement:
theorem componentSum_vertexDelta
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    componentSum (V := V) G (vertexDelta (V := V) u) c =
      componentIndicator (V := V) G c u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [componentSum_apply]
  simp [vertexDelta]

name: P3.componentSum_edgeDifference
statement:
theorem componentSum_edgeDifference
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    componentSum (V := V) G (edgeDifference (V := V) u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDifference, LinearMap.map_sub]
  ext c
  rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
      componentSum_vertexDelta, componentSum_vertexDelta]
  have hcomp :
      G.connectedComponentMk u = G.connectedComponentMk v :=
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj huv
  rw [componentIndicator_eq_of_mk_eq (V := V) G hcomp c]
  exact sub_self _

name: P3.incidenceSpace_le_componentSum_ker
statement:
theorem incidenceSpace_le_componentSum_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    incidenceSpace (V := V) G ≤
      (componentSum (V := V) G).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩
  change componentSum (V := V) G
      (edgeDifference (V := V) u v) = 0
  exact componentSum_edgeDifference (V := V) G huv

name: P3.connectedComponentMk_componentRep
statement:
@[simp]
theorem connectedComponentMk_componentRep
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    G.connectedComponentMk (componentRep (V := V) G c) = c
proof:
:= by
  change Quot.mk G.Reachable (Quot.out c) = c
  exact Quot.out_eq c

name: P3.componentRep_same_component
statement:
theorem componentRep_same_component
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    G.connectedComponentMk (componentRep (V := V) G c) = c
proof:
:=
  connectedComponentMk_componentRep (V := V) G c

name: P3.componentSum_vertexDelta_componentRep
statement:
theorem componentSum_vertexDelta_componentRep
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (c c' : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    componentSum (V := V) G
        (vertexDelta (V := V) (componentRep (V := V) G c)) c' =
      componentIndicator (V := V) G c'
        (componentRep (V := V) G c)
proof:
:= by
  exact componentSum_vertexDelta (V := V) G
    (componentRep (V := V) G c) c'

name: P3.componentSum_surjective
statement:
theorem componentSum_surjective
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Function.Surjective (componentSum (V := V) G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y
  let x : GraphVertexSpace V :=
    ∑ c : G.ConnectedComponent,
      y c • vertexDelta (V := V) (componentRep (V := V) G c)
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  ext c
  rw [show x =
      ∑ c' : G.ConnectedComponent,
        y c' • vertexDelta (V := V) (componentRep (V := V) G c') by rfl]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [componentSum_vertexDelta_componentRep (V := V)]
  simp [componentIndicator, connectedComponentMk_componentRep]

name: P3.componentSum_range_eq_top
statement:
theorem componentSum_range_eq_top
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    LinearMap.range (componentSum (V := V) G) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (componentSum_surjective (V := V) G)

name: P3.finrank_graphVertexSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_graphVertexSpace :
    Module.finrank ℂ (GraphVertexSpace V) = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphVertexSpace]

name: P3.finrank_componentSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_componentSpace
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (G.ConnectedComponent → ℂ) =
      componentCount (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi]
  simp [componentCount]

name: P3.finrank_componentSum_range
statement:
theorem finrank_componentSum_range
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(LinearMap.range (componentSum (V := V) G)) =
      componentCount (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentSum_range_eq_top (V := V) G]
  simpa using finrank_componentSpace (V := V) G

name: P3.finrank_componentSum_ker
statement:
theorem finrank_componentSum_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥((componentSum (V := V) G).ker) =
      Fintype.card V - componentCount (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
      (componentSum (V := V) G)
  rw [finrank_componentSum_range (V := V) G,
      finrank_graphVertexSpace (V := V)] at h
  exact Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq' h

name: P3.componentCoefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem componentCoefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : GraphVertexSpace V)
    (hx : x ∈ (componentSum (V := V) G).ker)
    (c : G.ConnectedComponent) :
    (∑ v : V, componentIndicator (V := V) G c v * x v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change componentSum (V := V) G x = 0 at hx
  have hc := congrFun hx c
  rw [Pi.zero_apply, componentSum_apply] at hc
  exact hc

name: P3.sum_smul_vertexDelta
statement:
theorem sum_smul_vertexDelta
    (x : GraphVertexSpace V) :
    (∑ v : V, x v • vertexDelta (V := V) v) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext u
  simp [vertexDelta]

name: P3.representativeCorrection_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem representativeCorrection_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : GraphVertexSpace V)
    (hx : x ∈ (componentSum (V := V) G).ker) :
    (∑ v : V,
      x v • vertexDelta (V := V)
        (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext u
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    vertexDelta_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  by_cases hu :
      componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk u) = u
  · have hiff (v : V) :
        u = componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v) ↔
          G.connectedComponentMk v = G.connectedComponentMk u := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hmk := congrArg G.connectedComponentMk h
        have hrep :
            G.connectedComponentMk
                (componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v)) =
              G.connectedComponentMk v :=
          connectedComponentMk_componentRep
            (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v)
        exact (hmk.trans hrep).symm
      · intro h
        have hrep :=
          congrArg (componentRep (V := V) G) h
        calc
          u = componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk u) := hu.symm
          _ = componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v) := hrep.symm
    have hc :=
      componentCoefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
        (V := V) G x hx (G.connectedComponentMk u)
    simpa [componentIndicator, hiff, mul_comm] using hc
  · apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro v hv
    have hne :
        u ≠ componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v) := by
      intro h
      have hmk := congrArg G.connectedComponentMk h
      have hcomp :
          G.connectedComponentMk u = G.connectedComponentMk v := by
        exact hmk.trans
          (connectedComponentMk_componentRep
            (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v))
      have hrep :=
        congrArg (componentRep (V := V) G) hcomp
      apply hu
      calc
        componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk u) =
            componentRep (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v) := hrep
        _ = u := h.symm
    simp [hne]

name: P3.representativeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace
statement:
theorem representativeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : GraphVertexSpace V) :
    representativeDifference (V := V) G x ∈
      incidenceSpace (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro v hv
  apply (incidenceSpace (V := V) G).smul_mem
  apply edgeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace_of_component_eq (V := V) G
  rw [connectedComponentMk_componentRep
    (V := V) G (G.connectedComponentMk v)]

name: P3.representativeDifference_eq_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem representativeDifference_eq_of_mem_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : GraphVertexSpace V)
    (hx : x ∈ (componentSum (V := V) G).ker) :
    representativeDifference (V := V) G x = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold representativeDifference
  simp_rw [edgeDifference, smul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_smul_vertexDelta (V := V) x]
  rw [representativeCorrection_eq_zero_of_mem_ker (V := V) G x hx]
  exact sub_zero x

name: P3.componentSum_ker_le_incidenceSpace
statement:
theorem componentSum_ker_le_incidenceSpace
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (componentSum (V := V) G).ker ≤ incidenceSpace (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hmem :=
    representativeDifference_mem_incidenceSpace (V := V) G x
  rw [representativeDifference_eq_of_mem_ker (V := V) G x hx] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: P3.incidenceSpace_eq_componentSum_ker
statement:
theorem incidenceSpace_eq_componentSum_ker
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    incidenceSpace (V := V) G =
      (componentSum (V := V) G).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact incidenceSpace_le_componentSum_ker (V := V) G
  · exact componentSum_ker_le_incidenceSpace (V := V) G

name: P3.incidence_rank
statement:
theorem incidence_rank
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(incidenceSpace (V := V) G) =
      Fintype.card V - componentCount (V := V) G
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceSpace_eq_componentSum_ker (V := V) G]
  exact finrank_componentSum_ker (V := V) G
